title: Store to a specified address and value
statement: Let a program, depth bound, list $l$ of integers, memory map $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, time bound $T\in\mathbb N$, postcondition $Q$, expressions $a,e$, address $b\in\mathbb N$, and value $z\in\mathbb Z$ be given. If $Q$ holds in the state with locations given by the frame of $l$ and memory updated at $b$ to $z$, if $a$ and $e$ are safe in the state with those locations and original memory and evaluate respectively to $b$ and $z$, and if $b$ is a valid address, then storing $e$ at address $a$ ends in a state satisfying $Q$ within time $T$, provided the store cost $\operatorname{cost}(a)+\operatorname{cost}(e)+1$ is at most $T$.
hypotheses_covered: The postcondition holds after updating memory at $b$ to $z$
The address expression is safe and evaluates to $b$ in the original state
The value expression is safe and evaluates to $z$ in the original state
$b$ is less than the space bound
The store cost is at most $T$
